Consumers of step_up codes: only POST /v1/auth/step-up (verifies against the decrypted bound phone). Contract: sendSmsCode x-auth, security, x-error-codes += 10001, SendSmsCodeRequest required [purpose] + if/then; regenerated openapi.gen.ts, auth-routes.gen.ts, route-schemas.gen.ts; contracts/oasdiff-accepted.txt lists request-body-if-added / then-added for POST /v1/auth/sms-codes (D10-1598 ①). 机械改动，D10-1600 / D10-1601: a fresh independent Claude put Me.masked_phone back to main (openapi Me field and example, identity me.ts / me-reads.ts, the createMeService crypto option) — those files are byte-identical to main.
